As-extruded GW102K alloy consolidated at 400 ◦C contained mainly three phases, i.e., /H9251-Mg, /H9253phase and Mg 24(Gd,Y)5, respectively [2].

He et al. [14] reported the crystal structure of cuboid-shaped /H9253phase particles was identified as face-centered cubic (fcc) with a = 0.56 nm. The composition of /H9253was determined to be approximately Mg 5(Gd,Y) by EDS in TEM mode [14].

The precipitated Mg 24(Gd,Y)5 would reduce the RE content in the matrix, which cause to decrease the amount of the precipitated metastable RE-containing /H9252′phase during the aging.
